answer: Falsifiable-forecast escrow locks payout behind a dated, checkable prediction. An author stakes a forecast about a future event and its settlement date; earnings stay frozen until the outcome arrives and release only if correct. Calibration across many rounds, not one lucky hit, sets the rate. A sybil farm reusing one forecast across its wallets shares one outcome, collapsing into one source whose correlated payouts are slashed. Honest forecasters draw on an ocean of researched calls, each on its own ridge; the shared trellis of clones buckles. Cost: real predictive work per identity.
